source.chapter_title: Results of the Antardasas in the Mahadasa of the Moon

notes: Each antardasha is judged from the sub-period lord's dignity and house, and its position counted from the mahadasha lord. Warnings attached to lordship of the 2nd/7th (maraka), named diseases, deaths and the remedial rituals that close each section are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy.

skipped.reason: Moon-Mars favourable results: these pages are out of order in the scan and could not be read reliably.

rules.text: Moon-Moon: with the Moon dignified, in an angle, trine or the 11th, or with the 9th or 10th lord — vehicles and fine clothes, confidence in one's convictions, devotion and prayer answered, high position, great happiness and growing fame.

Moon-Mars: Mars under malefic influence in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or badly placed from the Moon — health needs care, losses in farming or business, conflict with siblings, opposition from authority and harsh words exchanged daily.
Moon-Rahu: with Rahu in an angle or trine, a little good at the start, then trouble from opponents, fear, theft, friction with authority, loss of a friend, embarrassment and mental distress.

Moon-Rahu: Rahu in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th with benefic influence — success in all work and in favourite pursuits, a meeting with someone in power (towards the west or south-west), vehicles and clothes.
Moon-Rahu: Rahu in the 8th or 12th from the Moon — mental conflict, worry over a child, the spouse's or one's own health needing care, and trouble from theft or authority.
Moon-Rahu: Rahu in an angle, trine, 3rd or 11th from the 10th lord — pilgrimage, a sense of the divine, and a turn towards charitable and religious work.

Moon-Jupiter: with Jupiter in an angle, trine or the 11th, or exalted or in its own sign — high position, grand functions, clothes and ornaments, the goodwill of authority, conception or the birth of a child, good works, wealth, land and vehicles, and success in auspicious undertakings.

variants.text: Jupiter is also well placed from the Moon: provisions and clothes, happiness from siblings, property, patient effort, religious practice, weddings and festivities, and gains from government.

rules.text: Moon-Jupiter: with Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated or combust — lapses of principle, trouble concerning a teacher or children, upheaval at home, grief or a sudden dispute, and damage to house, land, vehicle or belongings.
Moon-Jupiter: a weak Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon — poor diet and foreign travel; the period opens happily and ends in conflict.

Moon-Saturn: with Saturn in an angle, trine or the 11th, dignified, or under benefic influence — wealth, friendships, children, business success through official favour, more house and farmland, welfare and status.

variants.text: Saturn is in an angle or trine from the Moon: comforts and gains come at times, alongside opposition from spouse and children.

rules.text: Moon-Saturn: with Saturn in the 2nd, 6th, 8th or 12th or debilitated — visits to holy places, ill-treatment from various people and trouble from opponents.

Moon-Mercury: with Mercury in an angle, trine or the 11th, or dignified — gains of money, honours from authority, fine clothes, learned debate and deepening knowledge, the birth of a child, contentment, profitable business and a costly, well-fitted vehicle.

variants.text: Mercury is also well placed from the Moon: marriage, worship and charity, the company of scholars, gems, vehicles, clothes and ornaments, good health, affection and comfort.

rules.text: Moon-Mercury: Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon or debilitated — physical discomfort, damage to crops, livestock or land, restriction, and trouble for spouse and children.

Moon-Ketu: with Ketu in an angle, trine, the 3rd or the 11th — gains of money, great enjoyment, happiness for spouse and children, and religious activity; a financial dip at the start gives way to a high level of comfort in the middle.

variants.text: Ketu is also in an angle, trine or the 11th from the Moon: money, comforts and livestock come at the start, with a loss of money towards the end.

rules.text: Moon-Ketu: Ketu in the 6th or 8th from the Moon under malefic influence — a venture lost to rivals and a sudden setback.

Moon-Venus: with Venus in an angle, trine or the 11th, or exalted or in its own sign — high position, a vehicle, clothes and ornaments through official generosity, a happy married life, an addition to the family, a new house, fine food and good health.

variants.text: Venus is with the Moon: better physical comfort, fame, happiness, property, house and land.
Venus dignified in the 2nd: an unexpected windfall, abundant comfort, profit from land and the birth of a child.
Venus with the 9th or 11th lord: a rise in fortune, comforts through official favour, success in chosen work, and gems.
Venus is in an angle, trine or the 11th from the Moon: more land and property, gains of money and abundant happiness.

rules.text: Moon-Venus: Venus debilitated or combust and under malefic influence — loss of land or livestock, strain around children, a friend or the spouse, and confrontation with authority.
Moon-Venus: Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon — a move far from home, sorrow, and risk of theft.

Moon-Sun: with the Sun exalted, in its own sign, or in an angle, trine, the 2nd, 3rd or 11th — recovery of a lost position or lost money, welfare at home, control of land through the favour of friends and authority, the birth of a child and plenty at home.
Moon-Sun: the Sun with a malefic in the 8th or 12th from the Moon — trouble from authority or theft, health needing care, and stressful foreign travel.
